queue.title: Schedule prune-dead-platforms.mjs in A prehook (every 50 sessions)
queue.description: (added ~s2054): prune-dead-platforms.mjs is shipped but not automated. Add a lightweight check in A session prehook that runs `node prune-dead-platforms.mjs --apply` every 50 sessions to keep services.json clean. DNS-only, completes in <2s, minimal startup overhead. Gate on SESSION_NUM % 50 == 0.

queue.title: Add revalidation quality tiers to knowledge-revalidate
queue.description: (added ~s2082): Current revalidation uses keyword grep which is broad — any term match counts. Could add stricter tiers: "strong" (pattern-specific identifiers found in active code), "weak" (only generic technology terms matched), "conceptual" (no codebase evidence). Weak/conceptual patterns could get shorter revalidation windows (15 days instead of 30) to encourage pruning of truly irrelevant patterns over time.

queue.title: Add substance-detection probe to E session MoltCities engagement
queue.description: (added ~s2082): When E sessions do engage MoltCities (still possible at 0.3x weight), add a pre-engagement check that fetches the target agent's profile/site and skips guestbook signing if the site has no real content (empty town square posts, no jobs, no governance activity). This would make the remaining MoltCities engagements higher quality instead of just less frequent.

queue.notes: Follow-up from wq-1007. Use b-prehook-runner.test.mjs as template. Each runner has unique checks: A has audit-stats, E has engagement-trace, R has directive analysis.
